description: The Sparrow Hawk from Retronix Technology is a single-board computer built around the Renesas R-Car V4H processor. Originally developed for automotive applications, the R-Car V4H combines Arm Cortex-A76 and Cortex-R52 CPU cores with integrated graphics and AI acceleration. title: Sparrow Hawk runs Linux on Renesas R-Car V4H SoC

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Radxa has announced two upcoming NAS systems, the DragonStation and DragonBay.
